# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph's Rule; The End of the Story

---

**23:1** And Joseph was wise and discerning in all his ways, and he prospered in everything he did, for the Lord God was with him.

**23:2** And Joseph ruled Egypt for eighty years, and in his time Egypt was in peace and prosperity, for Joseph administered the affairs of the land wisely.

**23:3** And the name of Joseph was great in all the land, and his fame went forth to the ends of the earth.

**23:4** And the children of Israel multiplied greatly in Egypt and were mighty and very numerous.

**23:5** And Joseph loved Aseneth all the days of his life and she was his only wife.

**23:6** And Aseneth was honored in the house of Joseph and among all the people of Egypt, and she was called the mother of all those who take refuge in the Lord God Most High.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
